title: Provision native VIXEN tools in assigned WSL worktrees before the MSVC gate
body: The assigned vxtrain checkout had Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools but no VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain pins and no Ninja on Windows PATH. The required native build could not start until the documented build.bat provision flow ran from the lane checkout through the box queue. Provision the pinned CMake/Ninja/Vulkan toolchain during worktree setup, or let the native build bootstrap it before admission, so the native gate starts from a ready checkout.

title: Run merged SDI freshness check in the default VIXEN build
body: The fresh full queued cmake build completed with 26 codegen checks while sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json --check exited 6 for eight stale merged headers. The documented recovery was to run queued sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json and then recheck. Wire the existing merged SDI freshness check and its generated C++ compile contract into the default build so a successful build cannot leave stale checked-in shader interfaces.

title: Include Visual Studio Build Tools in build.bat vswhere discovery
body: The queued native command build.bat all vixen-ninja exited 1 with “no Visual Studio install with the C++ x64 toolchain was found”, although the pinned VS 2022 Build Tools and vcvars64.bat were installed. build.bat calls vswhere -latest -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 without -products *, so vswhere omits the Build Tools product. The supported workaround is to call vcvars64.bat and run the vixen-ninja CMake preset directly. Include Build Tools in the launcher query so its documented native entry point works.

title: Make native lane cache and Ninja job cap automatic in the VIXEN build
body: The native witness requires VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<assigned-worktree>/.tmp/fetch and VIXEN_MAX_BUILD_JOBS=4, but the standard launcher does not derive the lane-local fetch cache or apply the lane four-job cap automatically. Have the native launcher derive these values from its own checkout and queue admission so native builds do not need manual environment setup.

title: Run native MSVC configuration through a mapped worktree path
body: The queued native build started build.bat from a WSL UNC worktree path; CMake's MSVC compiler probe launched cmd.exe with a UNC build-directory cwd and cmd.exe fell back to C:\Windows\system32, failing the link step. Recovery is to start cmd.exe from a local drive cwd, pushd the assigned WSL worktree to a temporary drive letter, then invoke build.bat through that drive; reconfigure after preserving the incomplete UNC-keyed build/ninja cache. Make the native entry point handle this path mapping and cache identity automatically.

title: Scope Windows Git safe-directory trust to VIXEN's WSL FetchContent cache
body: The native MSVC configure launched Windows Git against a FetchContent clone inside the assigned WSL worktree and failed with 'detected dubious ownership'; its diagnostic suggested a persistent global safe.directory entry. A process-scoped GIT_CONFIG_COUNT safe.directory pattern for this worktree's FetchContent directory allowed the clone to be read without changing user configuration. Have the native launcher scope that trust to its own cache or place native FetchContent clones on a Windows-owned path.

title: Detect WSL Dozen provisioning from the host instead of a shared source path
body: A native Windows CMake configure evaluated EXISTS /dev/dxg through the WSL-backed source drive and treated the Windows process as WSL. It then invoked wsl.exe with the temporary drive-letter cwd, which failed translation and left a nonfatal Dozen provisioning warning. Gate the optional Dozen provisioner on the actual configure host/runtime or make it use the WSL-native source path independently of the Windows worktree drive.

title: Emit reflected integer vectors as typed SDI push-block members
body: After the merged SDI headers were regenerated, consumers failed because signed and unsigned SPIR-V vectors were emitted as uint8_t byte arrays, which cannot bind the reflected glm::ivec2/uvec4 values. A manual generator fix now selects typed integer vector declarations from the reflected base type and width, with a regression test. Keep the merged C++ interface emitter aligned with reflected integer-vector types so regenerated headers compile without a downstream repair.

title: Resolve the pinned Yeroket root and snapshot cache per VIXEN worktree
body: The native Windows configure defaulted YEROKET_ROOT to /Github/Yeroket-Fantasy, which is absent here; the documented -DYEROKET_ROOT override must point through the assigned WSL share. Its pinned snapshot cache also defaults under LOCALAPPDATA, outside the lane worktree; the documented VIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR override keeps the generated archive inside .tmp. Make native root discovery and isolated cache placement worktree-aware.

title: Keep native VIXEN compiler caches inside the assigned worktree
body: build.bat defaults CCACHE_DIR and SCCACHE_DIR to C:\ccache and C:\sccache. An isolated native witness must override these paths to the assigned worktree's .tmp directories so generated cache data does not spill into another lane's or machine-wide storage. Derive per-worktree compiler-cache paths in the launcher while preserving user overrides.

title: Pass native CMake cache overrides through the locked VIXEN launcher
body: The documented -DYEROKET_ROOT and -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR settings are required for an isolated native configure, but build.bat's locked configure wrapper cannot forward cache arguments. I had to seed the preset cache with a queued direct CMake configure, then use build.bat build. Let the launcher accept and forward caller CMake arguments while retaining its configure lock and preset binary directory.

title: Make native kernel snapshot locking work in WSL worktrees
body: Queued Windows CMake configuration stalls in file(LOCK) at VixenKernelSnapshot.cmake:27 when the cache is inside the assigned WSL worktree. The same hang reproduced with a fresh lock file through both \wsl.localhost and \wsl$ paths, before the timeout or snapshot work; moving the cache outside the worktree is disallowed by lane isolation. Provide a Windows-over-WSL compatible lock or a supported worktree-local cache route, and keep snapshot ownership explicit.

title: Preserve graph-free shell materialization behavior
body: R504.1 moved shell derivation behind RenderGraph::TaskExecutor, but several existing BodyOctreeSceneNode render fixtures execute without an owning graph. To retain their prior synchronous publication semantics, this lane added a graph-free producer branch that synthesizes a completed AsyncRunResult and reuses the common publication path. Define graph ownership and standalone execution as an explicit node contract or provide a shared producer adapter, so each caller does not need its own body-level fallback.

title: Provide a root-aware native look-dev capture runner
body: To compare base and tip captures on the mandated Windows-filesystem route, I had to create a temporary batch file that accepts a checkout root, provisions vcvars/Vulkan, clears WSL ICD overrides, selects an optional look-dev state, and invokes that checkout's native CTest. The capture test itself is reusable, but the build tooling provides no root-parameterized native capture entry point for detached lane checkouts. Add one so native visual attribution does not require per-lane runner scripts.

title: Quote queued native batch arguments from WSL
body: The first queued command passed an unquoted C:\vixen-native\vxtrain\...bat path after cmd.exe /c; Bash removed the backslashes and cmd searched for C:vixen-native.... Quoting the full /c command string let the documented native setup proceed. Provide a canonical queued WSL-to-native batch wrapper that preserves Windows path separators.

title: Select a Ninja-visible WSL launcher for native codegen
body: The queued native Release build configured, then Ninja failed before compiling: C:/Windows/System32/wsl.exe was listed as a prerequisite for codegen/checks/octreeconfig_check.stamp but reported missing, although native cmd.exe can execute that path. Setting WSL_EXE to the installed C:/Users/liory/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WindowsApps/wsl.exe alias in the local native preset and rerunning configure allowed the build to start with codegen checks enabled. Have native configure select a launcher path Ninja can stat consistently.

title: Partition look-dev states under the CTest timeout
body: The queued default four-state look-dev test exceeded the 1200-second CTest budget in the repository's prior witness; I stopped this combined run at 4:53 and had to dispatch each state separately with VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_STATE. Make the CTest entry point split states automatically or provide a test argument that keeps each state within the timeout.

title: Use portable environment mutation in RenderGraph tests
body: The newly added GraphTaskLowering ScopedEnvironment used POSIX setenv/unsetenv and failed when its native MSVC test target compiled. I had to add a Windows _putenv_s branch while preserving the POSIX path. Provide one shared scoped environment helper for cross-platform tests so new fixtures cannot introduce platform-only libc calls.

title: Avoid Windows API macro names in the subgraph fixture
body: The native MSVC build expands Windows API macros named IN and OUT inside CONSTEXPR_NODE_CONFIG slot declarations, breaking the test before graph types are parsed. I had to rename fixture slots and ports to stable identifiers. Provide a Windows-safe declaration convention or catch reserved platform macro identifiers in the test authoring guidance.

title: Give the photon mirror target its required C++23 feature
body: The standalone photon mirror deliberately avoids linking the SVO archive, so it does not inherit SVO's public cxx_std_23 compile feature and MSVC defaults to an older language mode. I had to add target_compile_features directly. Derive the repository language level for standalone header-only test targets.

title: Avoid the Windows small macro in RecipeBaker tests
body: The native Release test build expands the Windows small macro over a RecipeEntry local named small. I had to rename the local before MSVC could compile the test. Add a shared cross-platform test naming rule or portability helper for Windows SDK macro collisions.

title: Expose native build lock waits to the box queue
body: A second queued native Release invocation configured, then run_build_with_summary.ps1 waited on the first checkout's machine-wide build lock with no CPU or log progress. The box queue marked that 276-second lock wait idle and killed it with exit 75 before compilation. I had to serialize native checkouts and resubmit after the first build released the lock. Make nested native lock waits visible to queue liveness or have the wrapper acquire/admit the lock before reserving a worker slot.

title: Isolate native Release Ninja metadata from a failed restat
body: On the tip's existing C:/vixen-native/vxtrain/build/vxtrain-native tree, the documented locked configure reached generation then failed at Ninja -t restat with 'failed recompaction: Permission denied'; file modes were writable, no Ninja process remained, and the exact base configured in its separate build directory. I had to add a fresh binary-directory preset and a matching locked Recovery A helper. Make the native launcher recover this stale/inaccessible Ninja metadata automatically or expose a supported fresh binary directory.

title: Set look-dev timeouts for the costliest individual states
body: The state-scoped queued CTest for VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_STATE=night-service exceeded its 1200-second timeout on the repeat capture after completing the first four-angle set. Splitting the four states (the existing proposal) is insufficient for this state. Reduce per-state render cost or let CTest derive a safe timeout from the selected state while preserving first/repeat byte checks.

title: Make native RecipeSimd generation checks self-consistent
body: The first native Release gate reported STALE for RecipeSimd.g.hpp at the recipe SIMD CodegenTool --check target. Running the same pinned RecipeOpDeclarations/Yeroket inputs through the documented emitter regenerated all outputs with zero line changes, and the immediate --check passed. Make the native build's generator/tool startup ensure the checked-in artifact and the --check output use the same fresh inputs/implementation, without requiring an extra manual regeneration pass.

title: Serialize concurrent builds over a shared FetchContent build directory
body: The parallel snapshot builds for after-gpuyield, after-lights0, and after-shellasync0 shared .tmp/vxtrain-attribution/deps as FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR. The queued command cmake --build .tmp/vxtrain-attribution/steps/after-shellasync0/build/wsl --target vixen_lookdev_capture --parallel 4 failed with a GCC internal compiler bus error while after-gpuyield was compiling the same deps/rmlui-build tree. Re-running that build sequentially completed successfully. Isolate each snapshot's FetchContent build products, or serialize worktree builds that share this cache.

title: Avoid Dozen device loss during memory-pressured look-dev captures
body: The queued wave-base look-dev run lost the Vulkan device at FrameSyncNode::vkWaitSemaphores and segfaulted after only two or three angle images while host PSI was high (midday: 1791725899; late afternoon: 1791726169; overcast: 1791726216; night service: 1791726137). Re-running the same 64-frame-per-angle capture on the exact base binary after concurrent build pressure cleared passed all four angles in 457,828 ms (1791727393), without source changes. Make GPU admission or the capture retry path account for this pressure-sensitive DZN device-loss failure so it is not misclassified as a source regression.

title: Provide a CodeGraph index for VIXEN worktrees
body: The required query codegraph explore "RenderGraph shell generation t0 stored and recipe baked body publication" exited because this checkout has no .codegraph index. The CLI says the project owner must enable it with codegraph init and directs agents not to initialize it. I continued with standard source tools. Publish or provide the owned CodeGraph index for dispatched VIXEN worktrees.

title: Resolve cmd.exe in queued native test commands
body: The queued payload cmd.exe /d /c ... exited before execution with cmd.exe: command not found. The supported WSL route worked when invoked through /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe. Make native queue invocations resolve the Windows command interpreter explicitly or preserve the interop PATH.

title: Preserve staged DLLs after vcvars in native CTest
body: Native Release CTest discovery of test_resource_management.exe failed with 0xc0000135 even though the caller prefixed PATH with the build binaries directory. run-r6.bat calls vcvars64.bat and then overwrites PATH. Adding ROOT\build\BUILD_DIR_NAME\binaries after vcvars made discovery proceed. Have the native test runner preserve target runtime DLL directories after toolchain setup.

title: Declare the editor script as R6 CTest setup
body: Filtered native GpuSubmissionsRespectDeclaredBudget failed because temp/run_editor_script.log was absent. The editor log is produced only by calling VIXEN/temp/run_editor_script.bat, and CTest runs from libraries/RenderGraph/tests. I had to run the editor script first and set VIXEN_EDITOR_CAPTURE_DIR to the absolute VIXEN/temp path for the CTest process. Model this producer as a CTest fixture and share its resolved output directory with the parser test.

title: Let native R6 launch the configured editor target
body: The R6 helper script expects VIXEN/binaries/vixen_editor.exe, while the fresh MSVC CMake target was emitted at build/vxtrain-native-fresh/binaries/vixen_editor.exe. I copied the executable by hand before the supported editor-script path could run. Accept the configured build output path or generate a root-aware R6 launcher that invokes the selected CMake target directly.

title: Run the mutex census from the native VIXEN build
body:
The native MSVC configure reports that the no-new-mutex gate is skipped because bash/python3 are unavailable, then asks for a separate WSL/CI invocation. I had to queue WARN: VIXEN/libraries/KernelDispatch/include/KernelDispatch/TaskExecutor.h: 3 owning declaration(s) declared but UNCLASSIFIED — needs an inventory row
WARN: VIXEN/libraries/KernelDispatch/src/TaskExecutor.cpp: 1 owning declaration(s) declared but UNCLASSIFIED — needs an inventory row
PASS: no-new-mutex — scanned 844 files, 83 mutex-syntax files, 47 owning declarations, 2 UNCLASSIFIED row(s) manually after the native build. Have the native launcher invoke this existing gate through WSL or make its skip status part of the native witness contract so the check is not a separate undocumented step.
